remarks: *THANK YOU FOR YOUR INTEREST: Seller has requested highest and best offers by Monday 3/9/26 at 3pm* Set on a tranquil acre on a three home spur back and off the road, this meticulous, move-in ready Colonial with a sparkling gunite pool & spa is the home you have been waiting for. The prime Westport location offers convenience to commuting options, town centers, schools, beaches & more. The professionally-landscaped property w/specimen plantings & artisanal stonework is the perfect backdrop for this classic Colonial. The home's interior was freshly painted in a neutral palate and the hardwood floors were just refinished. The front-to-back LR w/ the 1st fireplace has three exposures, filling it with light. The DR is ready to host memorable occasions. The custom gourmet kitchen has fresh white cabinetry, stone counters, Sub Zero & Wolf appliances including double wall ovens & gas cooktop, walk-in pantry and an effortless flow to the captivating brkfst rm w/French doors to both a deck & exquisite sun rm. The family rm is a signature highlight w/ skylit cathedral ceil, 2nd fpl, wet bar & French doors. Upstairs, the expanded primary suite has a king-sized BR, two large walk-in clsts & a unique, luxurious octagonal bth w/htd flr, glass shower & hydro tub. The spacious BRs access an updated full bath. Finished LL rec/play/gym space w/office plus lrg storage rm in addition to very spacious attic. The resort-style pool area has a waterfall spa, built-in grill/bar. Generator, 2c gar.
